description: Estimate US import duties in dollars for the goods on an international shipment, per commodity line, from current tariff rates (base HTS rate plus Section 301 / 232 and other chapter 99 measures). Each line needs a 10-digit HTS code (find it with hs_code_search), the country the goods were made in, and the line's declared value in USD. US imports only. It is an ESTIMATE, not a customs ruling: say so, and say it excludes the merchandise processing fee, harbor maintenance fee, broker fees and any per-unit duty it flags. Use it with international_quote to give the user a landed cost (freight + duty). Auth required; each account has a daily cap.

lines.description: One line per kind of goods

description.description: What the line is, to label the answer

origin.description: ISO alpha-2 country where the goods were made

value_usd.description: Declared customs value of this line, USD

mode.description: How the goods arrive: ocean or air

name: international_duty_estimate
title: Estimate US Import Duties
